strongest_angle: Snap Inc. reached a confidential settlement with two teenage plaintiffs in Los Angeles County Superior Court, averting a high-profile social media addiction bellwether jury trial.

key_facts.fact: Snap Inc. reached a confidential settlement in Los Angeles County Superior Court with two teenage plaintiffs named SJ and KDB, avoiding a bellwether trial.
The settlement agreement with Snap Inc. was reached partway through jury selection in Los Angeles, two days before opening statements.
Los Angeles County Superior Court was set to host the bellwether trial involving Snap Inc. before the confidential settlement was announced on Monday.

numbers.label: Days before trial when settlement was announced
